title: Soft-landing traffic taper and per-region circuit annealing (hotfix)
author: Leah Kim
description: Customer-facing incidents in clinics-east triggered rapid circuit flips and aggressive tenant evictions during a sustained latency hump. This PR introduces a soft-landing traffic taper that smoothly reduces new routing to stressed regional pools and a per-region "annealing" window for circuit state transitions so circuits reopen gradually instead of immediately after a short cool-down. Changes are conservative and intended as a hotfix: 1) new config: region.taper.window_ms and region.circuit.anneal_seconds with safe defaults; 2) routing shim that applies a percentile-based taper score before evicting or refusing traffic; 3) circuit state machine adjustment to prefer a staged REOPEN->PROBATION->ACTIVE path with exponential backoff in case of repeated re-failures; 4) telemetry: added metrics and traces for taper decisions and circuit annealing steps; 5) integration test harness simulating regional latency spikes and verifying no more than one flip per 30s on average. Rollout plan: canary 5% in clinics-east for 1 hour, expand to 25% for 3 hours, full rollout if no regression; feature flag region_soft_landing.v1 controls behavior and allows immediate rollback. Why this approach: previous immediate reopen behavior caused oscillation when downstream latencies were bursty; annealing plus tapering reduces oscillation while preserving availability for low-priority traffic. Related: ENG-7892 (investigate regional oscillation), ENG-7920 (slo enforcement follow-ups).

review_comments: Owen Zhang: Can you add a short safety threshold so the taper doesn't drive a target to zero during a major outage? Suggested: min_taper_percent 1%.
Leah Kim: Added min_taper_percent=0.01 and documented rationale in docs/decisions/2026-02-region-annealing.md. We keep it opt-out via feature flag.
Priya Nair: The new metric circuit_anneal_attempts looks useful but please tag spans so it links to region and tenant for easier debugging.
Leah Kim: Updated traces to annotate region and tenant_id. Also added a debug log gated behind debug_anneal=true to avoid noise in prod unless enabled.
Marco Silva: Verified integration test harness locally. One nit: use constant seeds for the spike RNG so CI is deterministic.
Leah Kim: Switched RNG to deterministic seed for CI runs and left random seed for local dev by default.
release_notes: Hotfix: introduce per-region circuit annealing and soft-landing traffic taper to reduce oscillation during sustained latency spikes. Configs: region.taper.window_ms, region.taper.min_percent, region.circuit.anneal_seconds. Controlled by feature flag region_soft_landing.v1. Rolling canary rollout planned.
